ds6b.name: DS6b_5EU_TimeCourse_RawData (Schmidt, Rohatgi, Brandman 2022)
ds6b.citation: Schmidt HB et al. Oxaliplatin disrupts nucleolar function through biophysical disintegration. Cell Reports 2022. doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2022.111629
ds6b.attribution: Images: Schmidt HB, Rohatgi R, Brandman O (2022), DS6b_5EU_TimeCourse_RawData, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6643490, CC BY 4.0. Originals are not redistributed; only aggregate values derived from them are stored.
ds6b.scope: U2OS FBL-sfGFP / NPM1-mTagRFP knock-in cells; 5-EU added during 30 min, 2 h or 4 h drug treatments (paper Figure 5C-E), clicked to Alexa Fluor 647 azide, mounted in ProLong Glass NucBlue. Olympus IX83, 40x/1.4 oil, ORCA-Fusion with 2 x 2 binning (OME DetectorSettings), single plane, uint16.
ds6b.channel_basis: Every registered file's embedded OME channel names and emission wavelengths (index 0 DAPI 455 nm, 1 TRITC 580 nm, 2 FITC 518 nm, 3 Cy5 670 nm) matched to the fluorophores the paper gives for these cells and this experiment: FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP knock-ins, 5-EU clicked to Alexa Fluor 647, NucBlue mounting medium (Methods, key resources table). This is the filter-name mapping of the registered DS6a demo scenes (TRITC = NPM1, Cy5 = 5-EU, DAPI = Hoechst); the order differs from DS6a and is read from each file's OME metadata, never from the file name. Visual check (2026-11-21, one 4hrs UntreatedWithEU and one UntreatedNoEU field): DAPI shows nuclei, TRITC nucleoli, Cy5 nucleolus-enriched signal only with 5-EU. FITC also shows cytoplasmic signal of unknown origin. Provider confirmation is not claimed.
ds6b.split_rule: Time point in the file name: 30min and 2hrs = tuning, 4hrs = evaluation (decision 4).

ds1.name: DS1_Morphometry_RawData (Schmidt, Rohatgi, Brandman 2022)
ds1.citation: Schmidt HB et al. Oxaliplatin disrupts nucleolar function through biophysical disintegration. Cell Reports 2022. doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2022.111629
ds1.attribution: Images: Schmidt HB, Rohatgi R, Brandman O (2022), DS1_Morphometry_RawData, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6643187, CC BY 4.0. Originals are not redistributed; only aggregate values derived from them are stored.
ds1.scope: HCT116 and U2OS FBL-sfGFP / NPM1-mTagRFP knock-in cells after 4 h treatments, fixed, imaged in the FITC and TRITC channels (paper Figure 1C, Methods). Olympus IX83, 40x/1.4 oil, ORCA-Fusion without binning, single plane, uint16 (14 significant bits). No nuclear stain. All files are dated 2022-03-08; they are not counted as independent experiments.
ds1.channel_basis: The paper does not label the channels of this record. Evidence: (1) every registered file's embedded OME names and emission wavelengths, index 0 TRITC 580 nm and index 1 FITC 518 nm; (2) the paper's cells carry exactly two fluorescent knock-ins, FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP, and the morphometry was acquired 'in the FITC and TRITC channels' and measured 'using the nucleolar marker NPM1' (Methods; Figure 1C legend); TRITC excites mTagRFP and FITC excites sfGFP; (3) the same filter-name mapping as DS6a and DS6b (TRITC = NPM1); (4) visual check (2026-11-21) of 40x_U2OS_Untreated_20220308_01_1101.tif: TRITC fills each nucleolus (granular component), FITC forms beads inside nucleoli (dense fibrillar component). Adopted: NPM1 = index 0, FBL = index 1. Provider confirmation is not claimed.
ds1.subset_rule: 15 files per cell line and condition: the smallest SHA-256 hex digests of the UTF-8 string 'cytellect-nucleolar-shape-validation/1:' + file name. Fixed before download; reads names only.
